title: Health Resort east wing room 316 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 316 of the Health Resort East wing on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 316 key (E316 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 316.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: - Western side of the lake, in an open suitcase behind the crashed minivan.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 316 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Red keycard spawn location
- One Weapon box (6x4)
- One Weapon box (6x2)
- One Medbag
- One SV-98 Spawn
- One attachment Spawn
